MOD = 1000000007

def binpow(x, n):
    return pow(x, n, MOD)

def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])

    if k == 0:
        print(binpow(p, p - 1))
        return
    if k == 1:
        print(binpow(p, p))
        return

    order = 1
    cur = k
    while True:
        cur = (cur * k) % p
        order += 1
        if cur == 1:
            break

    print(binpow(p, (p - 1) // order))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
